questions.label: How much does the leadership team share a common vision for the next 3-5 years?
How well is this vision known and understood across the whole organization?
How aligned are your day-to-day decisions with this long-term ambition?
Summarize in one sentence where you want to be in 3 years.
How clear and well understood is your revenue model across the whole leadership team?
How profitable and scalable is your current business model?
How well have you validated your key business model assumptions with real data?
Which assumption in your business model worries you the most right now?
How formalized and measurable are your annual objectives?
How regularly (weekly/monthly) does your team track these objectives?
How well do your current KPIs let you catch a problem before it becomes critical?
What is your most important objective this year, and where do you stand on it?
How well does your team complete what was planned, without constant drift?
How clear are priorities for each member of the leadership team?
How well do you know how to say no to opportunities that aren't a priority?
Which project or initiative should be stopped to free up capacity?
How well documented are your internal processes (not just in someone's head)?
How effectively could your organization function if a key team member left tomorrow?
How well does your current structure support your expected growth over the next 12 months?
What is the biggest organizational gap currently holding back your growth?
